questions.stem: A number is increased by \(20\)% and then decreased by \(15\)%. What is the net percentage change in the number?
questions.keySolution:
Let original number = \(100\).
After \(20\)% increase: \(120\).
After \(15\)% decrease: \(120 \times 0.85 = 102\).
Net change = \(+2\). Hence \(2\)% increase.

questions.stem: The population of a city increases by \(10\)% every year. If the current population is \(50000\), what will be the population after \(2\) years?
If the price of petrol increases by \(25\)% and a person wants to keep his expenditure unchanged, by what percentage should he reduce his consumption?
questions.keySolution:
Let initial consumption be \(C\) at price \(P\).
New price = \(1.25P\).
Required: \(1.25P \times x = PC \Rightarrow x = 0.8C\).
Hence reduction = \(20\)%.

questions.stem: A shopkeeper marks his goods \(40\)% above cost price and gives a discount of \(25\)%. What is his profit percentage?
questions.keySolution:
Cost price = \(100\).
Marked price = \(140\).
Selling price = \(140 \times 0.75 = 105\).
Profit = \(5\)% of cost.

questions.stem: The salary of an employee is first increased by \(15\)% and then decreased by \(10\)%. If his final salary is \(\text{Rs. }20700\), what was his original salary?
If \(A\) is \(30\)% more than \(B\) and \(C\) is \(20\)% less than \(B\), then by what percentage is \(A\) more than \(C\)?
The length and breadth of a rectangle are increased by \(20\)% and \(10\)% respectively. What is the percentage increase in its area?
A number when increased by \(12\)% becomes \(448\). What is \(25\)% of the original number?
If the radius of a circle is increased by \(50\)%, what is the percentage increase in its area?
The price of sugar is reduced by \(15\)%. A housewife can buy \(3\) kg more sugar for \(\text{Rs. }510\). What is the reduced price per kg?
questions.keySolution:
Let original price = \(P\) Rs/kg.
New price = \(0.85P\).
\(510/(0.85P) - 510/P = 3\).
Solving gives \(P = 40\). New price = \(34\) Rs/kg.

questions.stem: A student's marks in three subjects are in the ratio \(3:4:5\). If the marks are increased by \(10\)%, \(15\)% and \(20\)% respectively, what is the overall percentage increase?
questions.keySolution:
Let marks = \(3x, 4x, 5x\).
Total = \(12x\). New total = \(3x\times1.1 + 4x\times1.15 + 5x\times1.2 = 13.9x\).
Increase = \(1.9/12 \times 100 = 15.83\)% .

questions.stem: Two numbers are respectively \(25\)% and \(50\)% more than a third number. What percentage is the first number of the second?
In an election, candidate A gets \(60\)% of votes and wins by \(400\) votes. If \(20\)% of voters did not vote, what is the total number of eligible voters?
questions.keySolution:
Let eligible voters = \(x\).
Votes polled = \(0.8x\).
Margin = \(0.16x = 400 \Rightarrow x = 2500\).

questions.stem: The cost-of-living index increases from \(125\) to \(150\). What is the percentage increase in the cost of living?
A machine depreciates by \(10\)% annually. If its current value is \(\text{Rs. }72900\), what was its value \(2\) years ago?
If \(20\)% of \((A + B)\) equals \(25\)% of \((A − B)\), then what percentage of \(A\) is \(B\)?
The production of a factory increases by \(8\)% annually. If the current production is \(2700\) units, what will be the production after \(3\) years?
A person spends \(15\)% of his salary on rent, \(25\)% on food and saves \(40\)% of his salary. The remaining \(\text{Rs. }2000\) is spent on miscellaneous items. What is his salary?
The price of an item is reduced by \(20\)% and then increased by \(25\)%. What is the net change in price?
A student scores \(85\)% in Math, \(75\)% in Science and \(90\)% in English. If the weights are \(3:2:1\) respectively, what is his weighted average percentage?
In a mixture, milk and water are in the ratio \(4:1\). If \(10\)% of the mixture is replaced by water, what is the new ratio of milk to water?
questions.keySolution:
Total 5 parts; remove 0.5 part.
Milk left = \(3.6\), water left = \(0.9\).
Add 0.5 part water → water = \(1.4\).
Ratio = \(3.6:1.4 = 18:7\).

questions.stem: A man's salary is increased by \(20\)%, then decreased by \(10\)%, and finally increased by \(15\)%. What is the net percentage change in his salary?
If the side of a square is increased by \(40\)%, what is the percentage increase in its perimeter?
A number decreased by \(30\)% becomes \(140\). If the same number is increased by \(20\)%, what is the result?
The value of a car depreciates by \(15\)% every year. If its current value is \(\text{Rs. }361250\), what was its value \(3\) years ago?
A shopkeeper sells \(40\) items at a profit of \(25\)% and \(60\) items at a loss of \(10\)%. What is his overall profit or loss percentage?
questions.keySolution:
Assume CP = \(100\) each.
Total CP = \(10000\).
SP = \(40\times125 + 60\times90 = 10400\).
Profit = \(4\)%.

questions.stem: If \(25\)% of a number is \(15\) more than \(20\)% of the same number, find the number.
The population of a town decreases by \(5\)% annually. If the current population is \(19095\), what was the population \(2\) years ago?
A mixture contains \(20\)% alcohol. If \(4\) litres of water are added to \(16\) litres of this mixture, what is the percentage of alcohol in the new mixture?
questions.keySolution:
Alcohol = \(3.2\) L; new volume = \(20\) L.
Percentage = \(3.2/20 \times 100 = 16\)%.

questions.stem: If the price of wheat increases by \(20\)% and the consumption decreases by \(10\)%, what is the percentage change in expenditure?
A student gets \(30\)% marks in an exam and fails by \(25\) marks. If he gets \(40\)% marks, he passes by \(15\) marks. What are the maximum marks?
A number is first increased by \(10\)%, then decreased by \(20\)%, and finally increased by \(30\)%. What is the net percentage change?
In a class of \(50\) students, \(60\)% are girls. If \(10\)% of girls and \(15\)% of boys leave, what percentage of the remaining students are girls?
The length of a rectangle is increased by \(25\)% and its breadth is decreased by \(20\)%. What is the percentage change in its area?
A man invests \(\text{Rs. }12000\) at \(10\)% simple interest per annum. After how many years will his investment increase by \(50\)%?
In a solution, acid and water are in the ratio \(3:2\). If \(25\)% of the solution is replaced with pure acid, what is the new ratio of acid to water?
questions.keySolution:
Total 5 parts; remove 1.25.
Acid left = 2.25, water left = 1.5.
Add 1.25 acid → 3.5:1.5 = 7:3.

The price of a commodity decreases by \(10\)% every month. If the current price is \(\text{Rs. }729\), what was the price \(3\) months ago?
In an examination, \(30\)% students failed in Math, \(25\)% failed in Science and \(15\)% failed in both subjects. What percentage of students passed in both subjects?
A number is increased by \(x\)% to get \(120\) and decreased by the same \(x\)% to get \(80\). Find \(x\).
The population of a city increases by \(5\)% in the first year, \(8\)% in the second and \(12\)% in the third. If the initial population was \(100000\), what is the population after \(3\) years?
If \(75\)% of a number exceeds \(60\)% of the same number by \(30\), find the number.

In a factory, production increases by \(10\)% in the first year, decreases by \(5\)% in the second and increases by \(15\)% in the third. If initial production was \(1000\) units, what is the final production?
A shopkeeper marks an article \(50\)% above cost price and allows successive discounts of \(20\)% and \(15\)%. What is his profit or loss percentage?
If the height of a cylinder is increased by \(30\)% and its radius decreased by \(20\)%, what is the percentage change in its volume?
A man spends \(40\)% of his income on food, \(30\)% on rent and \(20\)% on other expenses. If he saves \(\text{Rs. }2000\), what is his total income?
The price of gold increases by \(25\)% in the first year and decreases by \(16\)% in the second year. What is the net percentage change over these two years?

In a competitive exam, \(20\)% questions are from Math, \(30\)% from Science and \(50\)% from GK. A student answers \(90\)% of Math, \(80\)% of Science and \(70\)% of GK correctly. What is his overall percentage?
